short_description: Healthie Telehealth is the integrated video visit feature within the Healthie practice management platform for wellness providers.
long_description: Healthie is an all-in-one practice management platform designed for nutritionists, dietitians, health coaches, and wellness providers, with the Telehealth module providing HIPAA-compliant video sessions. The platform combines EHR, scheduling, billing, client portal, and telehealth in a single solution. Healthie supports both individual and group video sessions and integrates with client engagement tools for program delivery. The platform is popular among wellness-focused practices seeking modern, integrated practice management.
